outcome: Adherence to Ministry of Health screening guidelines for diabetes in pregnancy (DiP)
cohort: Women without known diabetes before pregnancy who delivered in hospitals or community birth centres in the Waikato region, New Zealand, during June-August 2017.
finding: Overall adherence to screening guidelines for diabetes in pregnancy was poor, and screening rates were significantly lower in Maori women compared to non-Maori women, indicating marked ethnic inequity.
cross-section timing: Data reviewed for women who delivered between June-August 2017.
gest_age: Screening for DiP was assessed at <20 weeks and 24-28 weeks' gestation.
